description: Contracts for the Herald mediator library: request, handler, notification and pipeline behavior interfaces and the Unit type. Has no dependencies, so application and infrastructure layers can reference it.
A lightweight mediator library for .NET with requests and handlers, notifications and pipeline behaviors. Register it with AddHerald on Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.

Common parts of the Samhammer string trimming for ASP.NET Core MVC: [NoTrim] attribute and the model binder for route, query and form values. Use Samhammer.AspNetCore.StringTrimming.SystemTextJson or Samhammer.AspNetCore.StringTrimming.NewtonsoftJson for JSON bodies.
System.Text.Json support for the Samhammer string trimming: trims leading and trailing whitespace of all string inputs of ASP.NET Core MVC (JSON body, route, query and form values).
Newtonsoft.Json support for Samhammer.AspNetCore.StringTrimming: trims leading and trailing whitespace of all string inputs of ASP.NET Core MVC.
